stages.message: FOLLOW THE POLICE TO LARD LAD'S
HIT THE DONUT TRUCK AND COLLECT THE DONUTS
FOLLOW CLETUS AND COLLECT HIS STUFF
GET AWAY FROM THE BLACK SEDAN
GET "INMATE" CLOTHES AT THE SCHOOL, KWIK-E-MART OR BART'S ROOM
RACE CHIEF WIGGUM TO THE RETIREMENT CASTLE
FIND THE BULLIES IN THE SCHOOL PLAYGROUND
SEARCH FOR THE BLACK SEDAN IN FRONT OF THE SCHOOL
FOLLOW THE BLACK SEDAN AND COLLECT GRAMPA'S MEDS
GET AWAY FROM THE BLACK SEDAN
FIND CAFFEINE PILLS TO WAKE GRAMPA UP
COLLECT ALL OF THE BUZZ COLA
GET A POLICE UNIFORM AT THE SCHOOL, KWIK-E-MART OR BART'S ROOM
LOOK AT YOUR NEW OUTFIT IN THE WINDOW GLASS
DRIVE TO THE POWER PLANT PARKING LOT
CROSS THE FINISH LINE BEFORE TIME RUNS OUT
COMPLETE ALL LAPS AND FINISH FIRST
PASS ALL CHECKPOINTS AND FINISH FIRST
COMPLETE AN ENTIRE LAP BEFORE TIME RUNS OUT
